les.video_url_ph: Paste a YouTube link (or any video link)
les.video_about: The slide shows the video’s picture with a play button, and the title and channel as the source line. Clicking it in the .pptx opens the video.
les.video_bad: That doesn’t look like a link
les.not_meet: That class doesn’t meet that day on your timetable. You can still add it.
les.add_slot: Put it on another class or day
les.links_on_video: Links go on a Video slide: add one, then drop the link on it
les.pic_blocked: That site doesn’t let its pictures be copied this way. Right-click the picture, choose Copy image, then paste it here.
les.layout_keeps: Your text stays. Any new boxes start empty, with a gray hint of what goes there.
les.add_layout: Add a slide with another layout…
les.ex_added: Strong example added on a new slide
les.ex_added_n: Strong example added, one page on each of {n} slides
